entities.summary: Hovik Argami Abrahamyan, also known by the nickname Muk, is an Armenian politician, former member of the ruling Republican Party, he was the prime minister of Armenia from 13 April 2014 to 8 September 2016. Previously he was the president of the National Assembly of Armenia.
